user.title: Together School
user.description: Sign in with the mobile number registered in your child's profile. Your password is only used once to obtain an access token and is never stored.

data_description.login: In international format, e.g. +32470000000 - the same one you use in the app.
data_description.school_code: The subdomain of your school's Together School site. Open the app's web address or ask your transport office; it is the part before '.together-school.com'.
data_description.active_hours_only: Saves requests: outside school-run hours the bus is not moving anyway.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Together School
reauth_confirm.description: The stored access token for {login} is no longer valid. Enter your password once to get a new one.

tenant.title: Tenant ID
tenant.description: The tenant id for '{school_code}' could not be read automatically. You can find it in your school's web config at https://{school_code}.together-school.com/environment.values.js

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check the mobile number (not the email address) and the password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Together School backend.
error.invalid_school_code: That does not look like a school code. Use just the subdomain, e.g. the part before '.together-school.com'.

init.title: Polling
init.description: The integration only queries during the times below, when a bus can actually be running. Adjust them to your school's timetable.

data_description.active_windows: Local times as HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas. Example: 06:45-08:45, 14:45-17:15

error.invalid_windows: Use the format HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas, with the start before the end.
